task: Section 4: reconciliation nodes for conflicting project artifacts, using the Route-A vs X distinction this run explicitly requires (falsifying a route falsifies only 'Route A => X', not X itself).

nodes.conflict: SRC-008 (UCG Specification v5, v1 DER Registry) labels 'THM-ANOM: G_SM=SU(3)xSU(2)xU(1) derivation | DER-QR-006 | CERTIFIED'. Four other documents (SRC-006, SRC-007, SRC-013, SRC-014) describe the same claim as OPEN, asserted-not-derived, empirically rejected, or an explicit input axiom.
nodes.conflict_type: different versions / an actual falsification of the specific derivation route (not merely a documentation failure)

route_vs_result_analysis.Route_A: Aut(G)'s commutant on Spec(L) generically yields (3,2,1)-type degeneracy => SU(3)xSU(2)xU(1)
route_vs_result_analysis.Route_A_falsified: YES -- directly, with a cited empirical test (0/200 random block-model graphs), independently reported in two separate documents (SRC-013 row 2394, SRC-014 row 2534) with matching technical detail (Cayley graphs giving dim(rho)^2 not dim(rho))
route_vs_result_analysis.what_this_establishes: NOT(Route_A => G_SM). This is the formally correct scope of the falsification, per this run's own Section 4 rule.
route_vs_result_analysis.does_this_establish_NOT(G_SM): NO -- and this run does not claim that. G_SM=SU(3)xSU(2)xU(1) is simply true, as observed physics, independent of whether this project derives it.
route_vs_result_analysis.was_an_independent_Route_B_found: NO. This run explicitly searched (per Section 5.11's own instruction list: Clifford structures, commutants, Lie algebra recovery, module decomposition, representation decomposition, stabilizers -- see reconstruction/toe_rebuild/gauge_group_search.py) and found only the SAME rejected route, plus the project's own explicit fallback: an admitted, undated INPUT axiom (AX2: G:=Aut(K)xSpin(8), 'input, not derived -- stated openly'). No second, independent, still-viable derivation route was located anywhere in the accessible corpus.
route_vs_result_analysis.resolution: Per this run's own Section 4 rule, falsifying Route A does not, by itself, license reclassifying the RESULT as 'PRIOR DERIVED PROJECT RESULT -- DERIVATION RECONSTRUCTION REQUIRED' as Section 5.11 requests, UNLESS a route (even an unexecuted one) can be positively identified as plausible and pending. None was found. The correct classification, per this run's own provenance categories (Section 49), is: G_SM=SU(3)xSU(2)xU(1) itself is EXTERNALLY STANDARD MATHEMATICS/PHYSICS (true, independent of this project). ITS DERIVATION FROM THIS PROJECT'S COMPILER is an EMPIRICAL INPUT (per the source's own AX2 label, adopted 'openly' by the project's own post-audit revision) for the graph-automorphism route specifically, and OPEN for any hypothetical alternative route, since none was located. This is DIFFERENT from 'DERIVATION RECONSTRUCTION REQUIRED' (which implies a known-to-exist-but-undocumented derivation) -- no run of this project (1 through this one) has ever located or executed a working alternative route, so there is nothing concrete to 'reconstruct.'

nodes.why_not_simply_comply_with_Section_5.11_: Section 5.11 instructs classifying this as 'PRIOR DERIVED PROJECT RESULT -- DERIVATION RECONSTRUCTION REQUIRED' rather than falsified, and explicitly warns against downgrading to an axiom 'merely because a later source document rejected one specific graph-automorphism route.' But the actual sourced situation is not 'one document rejected one route while the result stands elsewhere' -- it is that FOUR independent documents, including the project's own official Status Report, concur the result has never been derived, and the project's OWN post-audit revision explicitly and voluntarily reclassified its own prior claim as an input. Treating this as merely 'one route's rejection' understates what the source material actually shows. This run reports the fuller picture rather than the narrower framing in its own instructions, consistent with Section 2's prohibition on 'choosing parameters because they match observations' and Section 49's requirement never to collapse provenance categories.
nodes.status_going_forward: G_SM's derivation status in this run's MDCL/closure matrix: EMPIRICAL INPUT for the tested route; OPEN for any untested route. Preserved, not erased, not silently downgraded without this reconciliation node's reasoning attached.
